# Nevergrad - The Classroom That Never Graduates
> Free browser-based school mystery visual novel — play instantly with no download. A 5-day choice-driven story with 7 endings.

## About
Nevergrad (졸업하지 못한 교실) is a free web-based school mystery visual novel game. Set in a school during cherry blossom season, follow a 5-day story with 5 heroines, 7 endings, and meaningful choices. Fully playable in the browser with no installation required.

## Features
- 100% browser-based — no download or install
- 5 unique heroines with distinct stories
- 7 different endings based on your choices
- Beautiful character art and backgrounds
- Mobile and desktop support
- Free to play
- 8 languages supported

## Supported Languages
- Korean (한국어)
- English
- Japanese (日本語)
- Spanish (Español)
- French (Français)
- German (Deutsch)
- Portuguese (Português)
- Simplified Chinese (简体中文)
